description.narrative: The project is implemented in Palestine . The main outcome areas it contributes to are democracy and human rights,peace and dialogue, just transition, and gender equality. The main rights holders are youth and women. Through alliance building progressive with civil society organizations, lobbying, advocacy campaigns pertaining to social equality and political rights, and contributing to social dialogue the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Al Marda Association and the Gteborgs Socialdemokratiska partidistrikt. AL Marda association work on mobilizing and organizing youth and women as well as strengthening role of women and youth CBOs to work together for sustainable development. Their main areas of concern include social and economic justice and supporting social movements for equality and rights.Other Donors to the OrganisationDED, GIZ No other donor to this specific projectProject ObjectiveDrawing the public policy of civil work and develop strategies to institutionalize the work inside the society for defending youth and women rights.Actor groupsDecision makers: Local Authorities Actors working in cooperation: local authorities , local supporting committees, youth and women CBOs and networks Right Holders: youth , women, and local supportive committees.
